title: Ieee7000 Standard
content:
- ### Definition
  - IEEE Standard Model Process for Addressing Ethical Concerns during System Design (IEEE 7000-2021), establishing systematic processes for incorporating ethical values such as transparency, sustainability, privacy, fairness, and accountability into technology development from concept exploration through implementation.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: spatial-computing:Ieee7000Standard
  - owl-role:: Concept
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[metaverse]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[Ethical Design Standard]]
  - enables:: [[Ethical Technology Development]]

- ### Content

  ## Standard Overview

  ### Core Purpose
  - Explicit consideration of ethical values
  - System design process integration
  - Concept exploration through development
  - Stakeholder communication support
  - Value traceability throughout design

  ### Scope
  - Innovation management alignment
  - System design approaches
  - Software engineering methods
  - Ethical risk mitigation
  - Implementable process framework

  ## Key Values Addressed

  ### Primary Ethical Concerns
  - Transparency in operations
  - Sustainability considerations
  - Privacy protection
  - Fairness and non-discrimination
  - Accountability mechanisms

  ### Value-Based Engineering
  - Value elicitation processes
  - Stakeholder engagement
  - Ethical value prioritisation
  - Operational concept alignment
  - Value disposition tracking

  ## IEEE 7000 Family

  ### Related Standards
  - IEEE P7006: Emulated Empathy in AI systems
  - IEEE 7010-2021: Wellbeing metrics
  - Affective computing guidelines
  - Emotion AI considerations

  ### Wellbeing Metrics
  - Human factors assessment
  - Intelligent system impact
  - Autonomous system effects
  - User wellbeing measurement

  ## Implementation Approach

  ### Process Phases
  - Value elicitation with stakeholders
  - Core ethical value identification
  - System-of-interest alignment
  - Design integration
  - Verification and validation

  ### Design Focus
  - Not primarily about "better AI"
  - Respects international value agreements
  - Human rights framework alignment
  - Regional law consideration
  - Technology-agnostic approach

  ## Industry Adoption

  ### Notable Implementations
  - City of Vienna "Mein Wien" platform
  - Accessibility focus
  - Trust and user control emphasis
  - Government procurement guidance

  ### Academic Integration
  - Stanford University curricula
  - Carnegie Mellon AI education
  - Engineering ethics programmes
  - Professional certification alignment

  ## Relationship to AI

  ### Clarifications
  - Not focused on algorithmic ethics
  - Not about ethical algorithms specifically
  - Framework for value-based decisions
  - Complements AI-specific guidance
  - Human intervention preserved

  ### Organisational Application
  - Governance structure support
  - Decision-making transparency
  - Stakeholder accountability
  - Continuous improvement processes
